name: Opd Appointment Booking
POST OPU Instructions
body:
Dear {{1}},

Hope you are doing well. Please follow the post Ovum Pick-Up (OPU) instructions
below:

* You may experience abdominal bloating for 2–3 days, which is common after the
procedure.

* You may notice light brown–coloured vaginal discharge; however, if the discharge
becomes excessive, please contact the health facility immediately.

* You can start with tea and biscuits 2–3 hours after the procedure.

* Please keep dinner light on the same day (e.g., dal, porridge).

* Take the discharge medicines as prescribed.

* Please follow up with the doctor on the given date.

If you have any concerns, feel free to contact us.

Regards,
HomeIVF Team

name: OPD Appointment Reschedule
PRE OPU Instructions-V3
body:
Dear {{1}},

Please review the following instructions before your Ovum Pick-Up (OPU) procedure:

• Maintain complete fasting (no food or water) for at least 6–8 hours before the procedure.
• Carry all medical documents and valid ID proof of the couple.
• Report to the centre at least 3 hours before the scheduled OPU time.
• Any delay in arrival will not be the responsibility of the centre.
• If the semen sample has not been frozen, the husband must accompany the patient as a fresh sample may be required.
• Do not apply makeup or nail polish on the day of the procedure.
• Medications: Essential medicines (such as anti-hypertensive or cardiac medicines) may be taken with small sips of water.

Please follow the anaesthesiologist’s instructions if provided.
The patient will be discharged 4–6 hours after the procedure depending on her condition.
If you have any concerns, feel free to contact us


Regards,
HomeIVF Team

name: POST ET INSTRUCTIONS
body:
Dear {{1}},
 
Follow the prescribed medicines strictly as per schedule.
 
1. Do not start or stop medication without consulting your doctor.
 
2. Avoid lifting heavy weights and strenuous exercise.
 
3. Normal routine activities are allowed.
 
4. Avoid outside food; prefer fresh, home cooked meals.
 
5. Focus on light activity and self-care. Full bed rest is not recommended.
 
6. Do not panic in case of spotting, mild bleeding, or light abdominal cramps. Contact the hospital immediately if needed.
 
For any other query, please contact the team
 
Regards
Team HomeIVF

name: PRE ET Instructions

3. Do not stop or start any medication without informing the concerned staff.
4. Please visit along with your spouse for consent formalities.
5. Do not apply nail polish, mehndi, perfume etc.
6. Wear comfortable, loose clothing.

Wishing you all the best.
Regards
Team HomeIVF
